Hi Rohan,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Bluebrook Security needs a tenant-scoped incident summary and a sampled set of logs for our internal audit and retention escrow. To be explicit:

- Deliverables requested: redacted incident summary (PDF) and a 72-hour sampled log extract for our tenant (bluebrook-prod-01).
- Sample constraints: please include request/response timestamps, request IDs, actor_id (pseudonymize if PII), route/model, and any authorization checks. We only need a representative sample (approx 10,000 rows or ~48 hours of high-level traffic) — you can compress.
- Redaction/PII: Remove any raw patient data and replace user_email/user_name with deterministic pseudonyms; please describe the redaction rules in the cover note.
- Chain-of-custody: we need a short statement of how the extract was created and a checksum for continuity.
- Retention: Bluebrook requests a 90-day escrow retention exception scoped to these artifacts; we'll treat delivery as evidence for our regulator.

Deadline: can you provide everything within 3 business days? If you need a secure upload mechanism or an S3 presigned URL with encryption, tell us the preference.

Appreciate a quick timeline.

Best,
Kate Turner
Sr. Security Operations
Bluebrook Health
